title: Cache-Line Aligned Condition-Variable Bounded Blocking Queue in Zig: Contention-Aware Design and Formal Guarantees
topic: Thread-Safe Bounded Blocking Queue with Condition Variables
description: Bounded blocking queues are a cornerstone of producer-consumer pipelines, yet achieving low latency on modern many-core CPUs requires careful handling of cache-line contention and memory ordering. This work presents a Zig implementation that couples a circular buffer with condition variables and a mutex to guarantee O(1) amortized enqueue/dequeue while preventing false sharing. We formalize two invariants---capacity preservation and linearizable ordering---and prove them under sequential consistency. Empirical evaluation on a 13th Gen Intel Core i9-13900HX processor (24 physical cores, 32 logical threads, 63.8 GB RAM, Windows 11) across N=30 iterations demonstrates a mean latency of 2217.02 us (P50: 2248.30 us, P99: 2496.20 us) and sustained throughput of 4.51 x 10^6 ops/s, confirming theoretical expectations and robust synchronization bounds.
